# JEDY Cleaning

> Professional house cleaning services in Knoxville, Tennessee.

## Business Summary

JEDY Cleaning Services provides residential cleaning services across the Greater Knoxville area. The company offers recurring cleaning, deep cleaning, move-in cleaning, move-out cleaning, and custom cleaning plans for homes and small businesses.
